Acid Spit: Attack: 5 Sec spit, acid damage 1d10 per Practitioner Title, range 3` per Practitioner Title.
Air Jets: Double swim speed for 10 sec, 10 min. to replinish.
Ambidextrous: 10 seconds of combat time, both hands, no off-hand penalties.
Antlers: Attack:5 sec/4 minimum, 1d4 damage piercing per antler, 1d4 antlers per Practitioner Title.
Barbed Tail: Attack:5 sec/4 minimum, 2d6+2 piercing damage, 50% chance to break off in pierced wound, 1d6+1 damage when removed.
Bioluminescence: Produces low light (equivalent of a candle, 20` of dim light) from a body area.
Blood Siphon: Siphon blood after another successful attack (or attatched to an open wound), does 1d4 base Endurance every 5 seconds.
Blowhole: Allows nearly continous swimming, +20% Swimming Skill.
Claws(Raking): Gives second raking claw attack when grappled, as other claws but +1 per die.
Dance Language: Can pass information through complex body movement, especially dance.
Desert Endurance: Delay need to drink or eat for up to one week.
Digestive Fluid: Attack: 1d10 acid damage per Practitioner Title per 10 seconds if within 5` range.
Disease Bearing: Carries a random or GM selected disease.
Diving(Aerial): No Agility save needed to avoid crashing from dives.
Diving(Water): Gains Diving Social Skill (or +20% to existing Diving Skill).
Dormant State(Advanced): Sleep for up to 1 month per Practitioner Title. Then wake ravenous, needing to ingest double food quantities for 1 day per week of hibernation. Physical attributes temporarily reduced by 1 per month of hibernation, returning by 1 per week after awakening. 2% of body weight is lost per month of hibernation and returns at 2% per week.
Echo Location: Locate objects within 2 feet per Intelligence.
Endurance: Grants +2 per Endurance per Practitioner Title.
Enhanced Hearing: Grants -20% to be surprised, +30% to Listen Skill.
Enhanced Taste: Identify poisons or impurities with a single drop/morsel.
Enhanced Touch: Grants +15% to perception search by touch.
Enhanced Touch(Whiskers): Grants +15% to perception search by touch.
Exceptionally Hearty: Takes four times as long to fatigue as normal for Vitality rating.
Exceptional Sight: Vision range x2, Missile Weapons +1 to Hit.

Extra Torsos(Segments): Gains additional segments like a worm or snake.
Farsight: Vison range x3, Missile Weapons +2 to Hit., +25% Surprise, -25% to be surprised.

Fluke: Increases swimming speed and the skill by 20%.
Flukes: Increases swimming speed and the skill by 20%.
Food Conservation: Half food intake, can go without twice as long.
Fused Torsos/Head: Torsos or head/torso fuse together, like a spider. Needs Extra Insect Arms/Insect Limbs to complete transformation.
Gas Bladder: Holds lighter than air gasses, maintains neutral buoyancy in air.
Gas Bag: Holds lighter than air gasses, maintains neutral buoyancy in air.
Glide Wings: Membranous tissue covering arm to thigh. Allows slow descent glide.
Glue Secretion: Glue can be secreted from a body area to make it adhesive, or smeared on a surface. Strength Save -20% for victim to escape.
Heat Sensing: Sense heat at a range of 2` per Intelligence.
Hibernation: Sleep for up to 1 month per Practitioner Title. Then wake ravenous, needing to ingest double food quantities for 1 day per week of hibernation. Physical attributes temporarily reduced by 1 per month of hibernation, returning by 1 per week after awakening. 2% of body weight is lost per month of hibernation and returns at 2% per week.
Hide(Bone): Gains 4 points of Hide per Practitioner Title (maximum of 25).
Hide(Carapace): Gains 4 points of Hide per Practitioner Title (maximum of 25).
Hide(Chitinous): Gains 5 points of Hide per Practitioner Title (maximum of 30).
Hide(Feathers): Gains 1 point of Hide per Practitioner Title (maximum of 10).
Hide(Fur): Gains 2 points of Hide per Practitioner Title (maximum of 15).
Hide(Scales): Gains 3 points of Hide per Practitioner Title (maximum of 20).
Hide(Skin): Gains 1 point of Hide per Practitioner Title (maximum of 10).
Hide(Thick): Gains 1 point of Hide per Practitioner Title (maximum of 10).
High Pain Threshold: Grants -1 damage per hit from weapons/energy.
Hooves: Grants 1.5 ground movement speed, Climb Skill -50%.
Horn: Attack: 5 Sec, 4 minimum, 1d6 piercing damage per Practitioner Title.
Horns: Attack: 5 Sec, 4 minimum, 1d4 piercing damage per horn, no more than 1d4 horns per Practitioner Title.
Hypnotic Gaze: Control Resistance or victim remains motionless until the being breaks contact or attacks.
Inflation: Increases the size of a specific body area by 20%, +20% to Intimidation Skill, -2 to damage taken to that area while inflated.
Ink Spray: Emits underwater ink spray, perception needed to find being. 10+ seconds after spray, double perception to find being. Usage once per minute per Title.
Insect Limbs: Gains extra pair of arms, forearms and claw-like hands.
Instinct(Food): Sense distance and direction of nearest food. Chance is Rating 13 vs Intelligence x 5%. Range 1 mile per Practitioner Title.
Instinct(Life): Sense distance and direction of nearest life. Chance is Rating 12 vs Intelligence x 5%. Range 1 mile per Practitioner Title.
Instinct(Social): Sense nearest animal or group matching the evoke animal form. Chance is Rating 15 vs Intelligence x 5%. Range 1 mile per Practitioner Title.
Instinct(Water): Sense distance and direction of nearest water. Chance is Rating 12 vs Intelligence x 5%. Range 1 mile per Practitioner Title.
Jumping: Jump x2 upward and x3 forward.
Marsupial Pouch: Gains a pouch able to hold 5 lb. per 100 lb. of Evoker.
Mandibles: Attack: 7 sec/5 minimum, 5d6 crushing damage. Smaller creatures must win contest of Strength to escape.

Metabolic Control(2-Stage Low): Shift between normal metabolism and very slow metabolism.

Metabolic Control(Low): Shift between normal metabolism and very slow metabolism.
Metabolism(Very Slow): -50% food intake/+20% weight,+2 Initiative, movement is 50%.
Mucous: Mucous can be secreted from a body area to make it adhesive, or smeared on a surface. Strength Save for victim to escape.
Musk Spray: Spray 1 victim per 5 sec. (automatic hit). Victim must make a Vitality save once per 10 sec. or be incapacitated.
Night Vision: Near darkness vision. Bright light: blinds 1d6+1 sec. -2 to hit/+1 initiative after.
Night Vision(Enhanced): Near darkness vision without bright light penalties.
Padded Feet: Movement on shifting/loose/slick surfaces is normal.
Patterned Fur: Grants +10% to Blend, +5% to Move Unseen in matching terrain.
Patterned Fur(Scales): Grants +10% to Blend, +5% to Move Unseen in matching terrain.
Pincers: Attack: 7 sec/5 minimum, 5d6 crushing damage. Smaller creatures must win contest of Strength to escape.
Pincers/Mandibles: Attack: 7 sec/5 minimum, 5d6 crushing damage. Smaller creatures must win contest of Strength to escape.

Regeneration(Natural): Limbs regrow at healing rate, but vitals kill, acid/fire stop regrowth.
Roar: 10 Intelligence or less beings/creatures flee in panic.
Roar/Scream: 10 Intelligence or less beings/creatures flee in panic.
Scream: 10 Intelligence or less beings/creatures flee in panic.

Force of Wood: Grants +30% to the Force Skill. Can also cause 1 point of structural damage per minute.
Light Regeneration: Regeneration of 1 point of damage, per 10 minutes in full sunlight, to all wounded areas.
Rooted: +20% to Brace Skill and any saves or contests involving Agility or Strength against being moved or toppled, cannot move while this ability is evoked and cannot be evoked over stone, metal or similar hard surface.

Tree Walk: Can enter any tree and then appear in any other tree in the same forest. A forest is defined as any group of trees where no tree is more than 100 feet from the next.
